chunks: And from him, from Hammad, from Shu'ayb, from Abi Basir, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:

If you do not know whether you have prayed four or two rak'ahs, then stand and perform two rak'ahs, then give salām, and perform two rak'ahs, then give salām, and perform two sajdahs while you are sitting, then give salām after them.

key_terms.سَلِّمْ: give the salām ending the prayer

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if they doubt whether they prayed two or four rak'ahs in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one who doubts in salat (prayer) whether he has prayed four rak'ahs or two. It instructs him to perform corrective units and sajdahs in a specific sequence, showing the detailed jurisprudence of remedying forgetfulness in prayer.
